    Straight answers before you start.

    We believe choosing a lawn-care company should feel simple. Here are the questions homeowners ask most often before requesting a quote.

    How quickly will I receive pricing?

    Most requests receive a response the same business day, Monday–Friday from 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. During peak season, it may be the next business morning.

    Do I have to sign a long-term contract?

    No. Service is month-to-month, so you stay because you value the service—not because you are locked into a long-term agreement.

    What should I expect after treatment?

    We apply professional products according to their labels and provide any applicable watering, mowing, pet, and re-entry instructions with your service communication.

    What areas does Grow Green service?

    We serve Greater Baton Rouge and nearby Ascension and Livingston Parish communities, including Prairieville, Gonzales, Denham Springs, Walker, Central, Zachary, and surrounding areas.
